pages.title: No air, no flame
pages.text: Late Phase 6 brings vacuum. Ordinary fire, torches, lanterns, candles, campfires, MiteAway burners and fuel-burning furnaces need breathable air. Exposed flames go out. Geometric room seals and enclosed oxygen supply use the same air rules as your suit diagnostics. Full glass roofs seal; open doors, open trapdoors and porous fences do not. Warmth alone does not supply oxygen.

pages.title: Recovery and exceptions
pages.text: Spent torches and extinguished lanterns stay in place and drop their normal items. Use flint and steel to relight them where breathable air is available. Campfires and candles use their normal relighting controls. Furnaces preserve unspent fuel and resume when air is restored. Soul fire, soul torches, soul lanterns and soul campfires are supernatural exceptions: they keep working, but supply no oxygen. Lava and powered or geothermal heat are not ordinary flames.
